_comment: Pharaoh's on-screen pad, for a tablet. It overrides the kit's built-in
tablet 'pad' for one reason: this game's only interactive chrome is the
control panel down the whole right edge of the screen - the minimap at
its top (x 612-752 of 800 in the device logs of docs/analysis.md) and the
build menu at its bottom (smoke/first-mission.script clicks 593,439 and
611,452 of 640x480). The built-in pad puts the face diamond and the right
stick in the bottom-right corner and the shoulders in the top-right one,
which is exactly that panel, and a finger on a control is claimed by the
overlay and never reaches the game.
So every control here is anchored to the left edge or the top centre, and
no offset reaches past ~640pt; the right third of any tablet screen stays
the game's. The right stick is not drawn at all: [controls.mapped] leaves
it on 'cursor' for a physical controller, but a finger on the map is a
better pointer than a stick, and drawing it would cost the panel again.
Geometry, sizes and the tab row otherwise follow the kit's built-in pad.
name: pad
